title: ID0376672-DC/Si-D/DE[160355321] - Ladevorgang an beiden Ausgängen abgebrochen
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Several charging session interruptions
Root cause:
Possible QA21-22 feedback problem
Solution:
No response
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Expired
A vehicle was parked at the cooled output (right) with the charging process active. A second vehicle was connected to the uncooled output (left). Then there was a clearly audible rattling noise (contactor?) from the charger, charging was aborted at both outputs.
Then there were several unsuccessful attempts to start a new charging process at the left (uncooled) output. Each time it was aborted in the cable check by the charger.

additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿colleagues,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / N8 160355321
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
cxGiFJ
Problem Description
: Charging session failed due to erratic behavior from QA21-22
Troubleshooting
:
There seems to be something wrong with the QA21-22 or at least in the circuit of the feedback. The command is ON so the coil is receiving the 24V and closing but the feedback is toggling too many times.
If at least one feedback worked then we wouldn't have this behavior as it only needs one contactor's feedback to work.
My recommendation is to see if you can replicate the issue and get the feedback to toggle, you can measure in the XD10.1A toggling between 0V and 24V.
If you are able to replicate this, please check where the 24V are lost, I assume that, since it's toggling, it's after the XD41:39A since this is where they join together.
XD41:39A output cable or the terminal
XD10.1A:4 output cable or terminal
Remove the cables, check for visual damage and reinsert
Cable from XD10.1A to KF4
Same as above
Input of the KF4
Check if there are no bended pins in the KF4
If you don't find the issue in one of these above please replace the QA21-22 and check if the charging session is now able to start properly.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0376672
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
